values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/burtonslanding ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Burton's Landing State Forest Campground: nightly fee $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-down access to the Au Sable River.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/burtonslanding ('There are vault toilets.' booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/burtonslanding ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' values.note: 12 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (agency wording, no length limit posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/burtonslanding + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Burton's Landing State Forest Campground: 12 campsites; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the banks of the main branch of the Au Sable River, 3.5 mi E of Grayling via M-72 and Burton's Landing Road; carry-down river access for paddling and trout fishing. --Claude
